title: Your store is slow on mobile. The 10-second test + 3 fixes
caption: Free test, 3 fixes, and the AI prompt that ranks them for you. Run it on your store tonight. #pagespeed #shopify #websitetips #ecommerce

beats.headline: Your store is *slow.*
beats.say: Most of your buyers shop on their *phone.* And on mobile, your store is probably slow.

beats.headline: Test it in *10 seconds*
beats.say: Here's the *free* ten-second test, and the exact fixes.
Go to PageSpeed Insights, paste your store link, and open the *mobile* tab. Under fifty? You're leaking sales.

beats.headline: The last one | nobody *checks.*
beats.say: Now, three fixes. The last one, nobody *checks.*
One. *Compress* every image before you upload it. Banners under three hundred kilobytes. Then kill the autoplay video and the six-slide slideshow. One strong image wins.
Two. *Delete* every app you're not actively using. Each one loads its own code on every page.
[surprise-oh] Three. Uninstalled apps often leave code behind in your theme. *Search* your theme files for the old app's name, or ask its support to remove it. Back up your theme first.

visual.prompt: Here's my PageSpeed report. Rank the fixes by impact for a Shopify store, with steps a non-developer can follow.

beats.say: Bonus. *Copy* the report into any AI and ask it to rank the fixes by impact, with steps a non-developer can follow.

beats.headline: Then *re-test*
beats.say: Then run the test again, and watch the score *climb.* [confirmation-en]

beats.headline: Speed is a | *sales* thing.
beats.say: Speed isn't a tech thing. It's a *sales* thing.

beats.label: Run it tonight
beats.headline: Follow for *more*
beats.say: *Save* this, run the test tonight, and follow for more store fixes.
